transcript: Tonight, my friend Bella and I attended. Regretfully so the Birds are at Playwrights Horizons, and it was super strange and outrageous in all the best ways. A lot of crazy stuff happens in this play, but it revolves around 3 siblings, all of whom are in their mid to late 20s and all of whom are feeling somewhat lost. They were each adopted from Asian countries that have never been disclosed to them by their white adoptive parents, who are also unhinged. And overall, this is a really hilarious story of both family dysfunction and personal exploration, full of oftentimes outlandish but compelling plot twists. But through this bizarre story, it somehow poignantly exudes a sense of honesty in its characters. And as an Asian adoptee, I thought it was cool to see a part of that experience, which is almost never seen on stage, really centered in this piece. With that, another program for my collection.
